changeSet.sql: UPDATE task current_task SET task_order = ordered.operation_index FROM ( SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY work_order_id ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC ) - 1 AS operation_index FROM task WHERE work_order_id IS NOT NULL ) ordered WHERE current_task.id = ordered.id;

UPDATE task current_task SET task_order = ordered.operation_index FROM ( SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY preventive_maintenance_id ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC ) - 1 AS operation_index FROM task WHERE work_order_id IS NULL AND preventive_maintenance_id IS NOT NULL ) ordered WHERE current_task.id = ordered.id;
